note: The book could not be opened from a machine. One web search for a full text of the second edition returned bookseller pages, a review, the AMS post-publication page and a PDF on a University of Maryland course site. The course-site PDF (https://www.cs.umd.edu/~gasarch/COURSES/752/S22/RTI-LR.pdf) is only the two-page errata sheet for the FIRST edition, dated June 23, 2004; it corrects Tables 2.1, 3.2 and 4.1 and mentions none of G(k,s), M(k,s) or w*(k;r). The AMS page (https://www.ams.org/publications/authors/books/postpub/stml-73) carries book metadata only (Second Edition, 2014, Student Mathematical Library vol. 73, ISBN-13 978-0-8218-9867-3) and lists no errata. So nothing was learned about whether the book corrects Table 1 of arXiv:0706.4420. This needs a person with the printed or electronic book. This record is inconclusive and does not fill either of the unit's two slots.
